title: Woman with 1960s Bouffant Hair, 1963 B&W Suburban Snapshot
description: A black and white square snapshot stamped JUN 63 on the front margin, depicting a smiling woman standing on a suburban front yard lawn. She displays quintessential 1960s fashion with a voluminous bouffant hairstyle, a pearl necklace, floral dress, and a white sweater draped over her shoulders. Behind her sits a mid-century ranch-style home featuring a Spanish tile roof and brick chimney.
